text: SpecDeck lets one person, the host, run a coding agent on their own computer, while teammates follow along from anywhere.
To host a session, pick your agent, such as Claude Code, or a plain terminal.
Then pick the project folder it should start in.
The agent starts in your terminal, and you use it as you normally would.
Share the invite code at the top. Copy takes the code, and the link button copies a link that opens SpecDeck and joins.
A teammate pastes the code under Join a session, and selects Join.
They see your terminal live and, for Claude Code, a timeline of every prompt, tool call and file change.
Viewers are read-only. Only you type, and the agent runs on your own login.
The faces at the top show who is watching. Select them to remove someone. End session stops it for everyone.
No app? Teammates can also watch in a browser. Hosting needs the app.
